author: ingolf-lohmann
body:
## Product-Owner decision

APPROVED

Implement a repository-native closure path so that a single Product-Owner decision can be carried through the already-defined verification and authority machinery without requiring the Product Owner to manually operate intermediate GitHub review/workflow states.

## Required transition

`OWNER_DECISION -> RESOLVE -> VERIFY -> AUTHORIZE -> EXECUTE -> OBSERVE -> MATERIALIZE -> CONTINUE`

## Requirements

1. Bind every owner decision to the live exact `base`, `head`, root `tree`, and semantic `scope`; any drift invalidates that binding and causes deterministic re-resolution rather than silent continuation.
2. Preserve authority separation: `OWNER_APPROVED` is not itself an independent GitHub Code-Owner review. A self-review rejection such as `Review Can not approve your own pull request` is a known orchestration state, not a Product-Owner-facing manual task.
3. Automatically continue through the repository-authorized independent review/executor/observer path when that continuation is uniquely determined.
4. Preserve all existing fail-closed effect/publication guards. Do not weaken actor, ref, confirmation, environment, authorization, exact-head, ancestry, remote-head, evidence, or integrity checks.
5. Classify intermediate states as:
   - `AUTO_RESOLVABLE`: repository machinery proceeds without Product-Owner intervention;
   - `WAITING`: an already-requested external/platform effect is pending observation;
   - `TRUE_BLOCKER`: only a genuinely non-deterministic or contradictory condition requiring a new human decision.
6. Surface `TRUE_BLOCKER` only with exact causal evidence and the smallest history-preserving next action.
7. Repository-native materialization and integrity projections remain mandatory; semantic payloads must not be rewritten merely to satisfy integrity machinery.
8. Do not infer independent review authority from bot comments or workflow dispositions.
9. Do not infer publication, merge, deployment, external effect, or terminal completion from an owner decision alone.
10. Preserve the standing canonical `/AI` semantic boundary unchanged; this work belongs to orchestration/infrastructure rather than rewriting the finished entry point.

## Acceptance criterion

For a review-ready candidate whose semantic review disposition is `APPROVE`, the Product Owner can issue exactly one `APPROVED` decision. From that point the repository either autonomously reaches the next evidentially established authorized state or returns exactly one `TRUE_BLOCKER`; no routine GitHub review/workflow navigation is delegated back to the Product Owner.

This issue authorizes implementation of the orchestration mechanism, not merge, publication, deployment, or bypass of independent authority requirements.
title: Deterministic Owner-Decision-to-Effect Closure
